items.question: What must be uttered after the namaḥ-word during the abhiṣeka rite?
items.inference: The verse prescribes uttering the namaḥ-word, then saying this śikta.
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of śiktaṃ is not specified in this verse
the precise grammatical gender of śiktaṃ depends on its referent
items.plain_english: Having uttered the word namaḥ, then let him say this śikta.
